title: Eerie Portrait in Abandoned Studio
description: A large ornate gold-framed portrait of a pale, bald alien-like child with large dark eyes stands in a dusty, dimly lit room. The figure wears a dark Victorian-style jacket and rests one hand on the frame's edge, surrounded by broken glass, torn canvases, and other neglected paintings in a decaying art studio.
prompt: A haunting surreal scene inside a decaying Victorian art studio filled with dust and torn canvases. A large ornate golden frame holds a portrait of a pale bald alien child with enormous dark eyes, wearing a black Victorian jacket with white lace collar. The figure leans forward with one hand resting on the bottom of the frame. Dramatic light beam from above illuminates the portrait while the rest of the room remains in deep shadow, scattered broken glass and discarded paintings on the floor, dark purple curtains, moody and unsettling atmosphere.
